title: Anatomy of a DJ booth · CDJ-3000X × DJM-A9
author: tiago-varandas
prompt: Build an interactive anatomy of a DJ booth featuring two CDJ-3000X players and one DJM-A9 4-channel mixer: an exploded, labeled technical diagram that is also playable. Every control creates or changes music in real time (original synthesized tracks, 124 BPM, A minor), while numbered callouts explain each part and pulses along the cables show the signal flow.
